build: UnrealEditor.exe -game Development, UE 5.8.2, rendered D3D12 SM6, 1280x720, 30 FPS cap; not packaged Shipping
comparison_implementation: Baseline restores BuildCampusInteriorPreview and UpdateBuildingTransparency verbatim from base_commit. Both DLLs include the same benchmark and cache-struct fields; the optimized Ensure helper is compiled but unused by the baseline visibility function.

protocol.garbage_collection: One explicit GC before the empty-app baseline; normal engine GC continues. No forced GC between loaded phases.
protocol.camera_and_ui: Actual TestingMap game world, native exterior EditScreenWidget. Camera-distance see-through disabled to control opaque state; selected building made transparent for reveal phases. Camera framed by normal project-load code.

statistic: For each process/phase take median of 10 samples, subtract its own empty-app median. For each same-iteration eager/lazy pair subtract lazy growth from eager growth. Report median and range of those paired differences. Positive means observed saving; negative means optimized growth was higher. These are sampled Windows process counters, not peak requirements or dedicated GPU memory.
excluded_runs: authored-lazy-pilot2 (harness validation, not included in comparison)
limitations: Single machine; three repeats for authored and generated workloads, one pair for footprint-only campus. Descriptive results, not a significance claim.
Working set includes shared resident pages and is affected by Windows trimming. Private committed bytes are not resident RAM. Neither measures dedicated GPU memory.
Includes editor executable/runtime, development facilities and benchmark; not packaged Shipping requirements.
Previously revealed previews remain cached. At all floors of a one-building project both variants retain the same room count.
Generated project is a synthetic ten-floor, 225-room building, not a measured real large authored campus.
Baseline subtraction reduces startup variation but cannot eliminate renderer/allocator/cache/OS variation. Samples may miss transient peaks.

native_counters.private_committed_bytes: FPlatformMemory::GetStats().UsedVirtual -> Windows PROCESS_MEMORY_COUNTERS.PagefileUsage (process commit charge, not virtual address reservations)

interpretation.resident_ram_savings_attribution: Inconclusive: generated opaque paired median difference is 13.13 MiB, but the no-room campus control differs by 10.11 MiB in the same phase and up to 22.27 MiB later. Do not attribute all observed differences to avoided preview allocations.
interpretation.small_authored_project: No consistent resident-RAM reduction; opaque private committed growth is higher in all three lazy runs.
interpretation.confirmed_behavior: Opaque preview actor counts fall from 9 to 0 for shipped authored data and 225 to 0 for generated data; first-floor counts fall from 9 to 3 and 225 to 22.
interpretation.converged_generated_state: Both variants retain 225 previews after all floors are revealed. Remaining observed differences also reflect allocation history, renderer/allocator caches and run variation.
